State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
Shanavas vs Jaseel Muhammed on 12 April, 2017
Daily Order 

KERALA STATE CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION SISUVIHARLANE VAZHUTHACADU THIRUVANANTHAPURAM

 

 

 

 APPEAL NO.38/16

 

 JUDGMENT DATED : 12.04.2017

 

 

 

 (Appeal filed against the order in CC.No.449/12 on the file of CDRF, Thrissur order dated : 30.10.2015)

 

 PRESENT

 

 

 

SRI.K.CHANDRADAS NADAR           : JUDICIAL MEMBER

 

SRI.V.V.JOSE                                  : MEMBER

 

 

 

 APPELLANTS

 

 

 

1. Shanavas,

 

Nokia Care, TC,XIX/122/788,

 

1st Floor, Achu's Centre,

 

Poothole

 

 

 

2. Shanavas,

 

Proprietor, Nokia Dealer,

 

Communications, MG Road

 

 

 

(By Adv.Sri.N.Chandrasekharan Nair & Adv.Sri.Saji.S.L)

 

 

 

 

 

Vs

 

 RESPONDENT

 

 

 

Jaseel Muhammed,

 

Jaseel Manzil, Nadam Padmam,

 

Palapilli.P.O. Thrissur - 680 304

 

 

 

(By Adv.Sri.P.Raj Mohan)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 JUDGMENT
SRI.V.V.JOSE  : MEMBER

 

        This is an appeal filed by the opposite parties under
section 15
of the Consumer Protection Act 1986, against the order in CC.No.449/12 dated 30.10.2015 on the file of CDRF, Trissur directing the opposite parties to refund Rs.6300/- as price of the mobile phone and Rs.5000/- as cost.
2.     The case of the complainant is as follows. He purchased a Nokia 300 half touch phone with 5 mega pix camera from second opposite party for Rs.6300/- on 14.02.2012 with one year warranty. The IME 1 number of phone is 358630046610160 and having 3G facility also. From 21.03.2012 it started defect in touch problem. The service centre people had inspected the phone and said the equipment affected software problem and assured to repair within half an hour. After one hour the staff of the service centre informed the hand set was dead. It can be repaired within fourteen days by sending it to the manufacturing company and when contacted again it was informed that it was not cured. So he approached the first opposite party, they demanded to put a signature in service job sheet. Also alleged that the complainant repaired it with third party, so they could not repair. This statement was unbelievable and baseless. It was caused by the deficiency of service of the first opposite party. On 22.05.2012 opposite party again informed to take back the equipment which can not be repaired. Hence this complaint in the District Forum.
3.     Opposite party filed detailed version. They admitted the purchase of the phone. The equipment was brought in with a damaged and tampered seal. The complainant repaired the equipment outside the service out let of opposite parties. They are not liable to pay damages or repair the phone because tempering with the machine by inserting third party machinery and software, voids the sale of contract and warranty. They denied all other allegations and prayed for a dismissal.
4.     The Lower Forum considered two points, Is there any deficiency on the part of opposite parties and if so, the cost and relief entitled to the complainant.
5.     The complainant filed proof affidavit and produced two documents. Ext.P1 and P2. They are purchase bill issued by the first opposite party and service job sheet issued by second opposite party. Opposite parties had filed counter proof affidavit and produced and marked two documents Exts. R1 & R2 which is service job sheet and photo copy of PCB, the same was marked as subject to proof.
6.     The complainant affirmed and narrated all averments stated in the complaint. He denied the repair of the equipment in an outside service outlet, as there was warranty for the equipment. The opposite party also affirmed all the averments in their version.
7.     The Forum Below has perused the documents produced by both parties.
8.     The averment of the opposite party that the complainant would have repaired the equipment in some outside agency is not acceptable to the form, because when warranty prevails why should they go outside. Anyway, both parties admitted that the equipment was damaged. Ext.P2 and R1 proved (both are same) the acceptance of the equipment for repair and same was not returned repaired or not repaired, which amounts to deficiency in service and ordered accordingly.
9.     Aggrieved by the above order the opposite parties preferred this appeal on various grounds. They alleged the Forum arrived in conclusion in an injustified manner. The Forum ignored the fact that the company seal was tempered, while entrusting the equipment for repair. Forum failed to consider the fact that Exts.P2 and R1 clearly shows that warranty is subjected to technical verification for liquid logged and tampering of hand set.
10.   The manufacturer was not impleaded as they gave the warranty. There was no expert evidence to prove the deficiency of the opposite parties. Appellant is only a reseller and hence not liable to pay compensation for the defect of the equipment.
Heard both sides and perused the records available.
11.   The purchase of the mobile phone on 14.02.2012 by the complainant and entrustment of the equipment on 21.03.2012 to the opposite party are admitted facts and evidenced by Ext.P1, P2 and R1 documents.  P2 and R1 are same documents. At the time of entrustment the opposite parties recorded the defects " data will be lost". On the other hand P2 document does not show any specific defect or specific observation with regard to the nature and condition of the phone entrusted. From Ext.P2, it is clear that the phone was disfunct as otherwise it will not be entrusted or accepted by the opposite party. While accepting the equipment a preliminary inspection has to be made regarding the apparent defects and an observation is to be made on the job sheet. But P2 document does  not indicate any such recordings. In the written version the opposite party admits that the phone was disorder and hence it was sent to the authorized service station. After few days, according to opposite party the complainant was informed that the phone is not repairable and it is tampered also from the authorized service station. However, complainant not collected the phone as he found that a phone which is capable functioning for many years and had a warranty of one year should not go irreparable within one month from the date of purchase.
12.   The opposite parties however has not taken any steps to establish that the phone has became defective due to mishandling or alleged tampering by the complainant. No oral evidence is also forthcoming. Hence it can be safely concluded. A brand new mobile phone purchased, became defective within one month from the date of purchase is only due to patent manufacturing defect and non resolving the defect or not replacing a brand new defect free mobile is a clear deficiency of service and the complainant is entitled to get back a brand new defect free mobile phone or its value paid by him.
13.   The opposite parties appears not acted responsible and initiated any efforts to get the customer a relief. The mere allegation that the phone set as tampered etc are unfounded. Similarly, the allegation the defect was not proved by sending it to an appropriate laboratory does not look legal or logical especially in this case, the defective phone is still in the hands of the opposite party. The grounds of appeal is not convincing or appealing. We don't find this case require any intervence of this commission as the same is not having any legal infirmities. The order of the Lower Forum is perfectly in order and does not warranty our intervention. The appeal lacks merit and hence liable to be dismissed. We do so.
In the result, the appeal is dismissed upholding the order of the Lower Forum in CC.No.449/12 dated 30.10.2015 on the file of CDRF, Thrissur.
In the circumstances, no cost.
V.V.JOSE                         : MEMBER
